item.title: Crackme drill — 2026-10-29
item.description:
# Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)
``` ror ecx, 4 xor ecx, 0FFFFh xor eax, eax cmp ecx, 1234ABCDh sete al ret ```
Which value of `ecx` makes the function return 1? Give it in hex.
Answer: **Answer:** `0x23454321`
1. `ror ecx, 4` rotates right: the low 4 bits wrap around into the top, so no bits are lost (unlike `shr`). Its inverse is `rol ecx, 4`. 2. The check needs `ror(ecx,4) ^ 0xFFFF == 0x1234ABCD`, so `ror(ecx,4) = 0x1234ABCD ^ 0xFFFF = 0x12345432`. 3. Undo the rotation with `rol 4`: `0x12345432` becomes `0x23454321`. The solution is unique, since xor and rotate are both bijections.
